name: The Life and Death of Louis FF de Bastin
source:
This is the story of a struggling artist trying to get ahead in an unspecified European city during the XIX to XX change of the century.

[From [url=https://jm-bueno.itch.io/the-life-and-death-of-louis-ff-de-bastin]Itch.io[/url]]
